review_evidence: README identifies the project as an HTTP client/server implementation for using Lean 4 as a general-purpose programming language and states that the implementation has moved toward Std.Http.

Complete scan of all 78 primary Lean files found zero theorem, lemma, axiom or example declarations; the modules define HTTP data structures, parsers, formatting, libuv-backed client/server IO and package/example code.
Representative Request and Client modules are executable protocol data/IO implementation, not a proved HTTP specification or formal semantics development.

source_action.content_invariant: Across all 78 primary Lean files, the project contains HTTP application/library implementation types, parsers and IO but no theorem/lemma/axiom/example declarations; retirement removes no independent mathematical theorem/proof or formal-semantics corpus.
